answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. What survives to the hollow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work. Each submission hangs on the saffron of a task receipt, and the willow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
